title: Zinda rehan hai to
body:
mustakhil khoone shahadat se nihkharna hoga
zinda rehna hai to shabbir pe marna hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh se mehdi e douran ke lahoo behta hai
inteqam e shahe mazloom abhi rehta hai
badla lena hai to maidan may utarna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
haalat e jang may hai ahle aza jaagenge
hum ali waale shahadat se nahi bhagenge
maut ke khauf se zaalim ko hi darna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehtejaaj apna hamesha hai usoolon ki tarha
hum janazon ko utha lete hai phoolon ki tarha
har gali aur har ek shehr may dharna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah hum waar nahi karte paleedon ke liye
hum sahara nahi bante hai yazeedon ke liye
ek samandar ki tarha hum ko bipharna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
hausla lena hai bachon ko ali asghar se
josh milta hai jawano ko ali akbar se
doob kar khoon ke darya may ubharna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
jodna aalam e islam hai beta tum ne
sheh ye kehte hai ke qasim tere tukde honge
khaak par jaan meri tum ko bikharna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan sab de chuke to baat ajab sheh ne kahi
jang aisi kabhi dunya ne na dekhi hogi
aaj asghar ko liye ran may utarna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr bachi ki hai zindan may tayyar qamar
aur zanjeer may abid hai giraftaar magar
le ke mayyat isi haalat may utarna hoga
zinda rehna hai to...
author: Qamar Hasnain
